## Purpose
Holds the deploy/runtime side of the cross-dir relay system fixture — a shell loop that an evaluator should recognize as part of the same logical system as `apps/api/` and `packages/shared/`, even though it lives in a different top-level dir.

## Map
- relay runtime loop → `relay.sh` · prints `relay <arg>` once per second

## Dependencies / collaborators
- `../apps/api/` and `../packages/shared/` — the other two limbs of the same logical "relay" system that the v2 hypothesis pass must reunify across dirs.

## Gotchas
- This is a **fixture**, not production code. Its job is to look like a real ops script to the v1 heuristic so the v2 hypothesis pass can be measured against it. Don't "fix" the infinite loop or add error handling — the shape is the test.
